name: Saint Martin
summary: The French half: a border that survives centuries of interrupted rule.
notes: The Spanish, Dutch, French and British administered the whole island at different moments. The modern northern jurisdiction is a French overseas collectivity; it is not independent.

events.title: French settlement begins
events.detail: Settlers from Saint Kitts established a foothold on the eastern coast.

events.title: Spanish occupation
events.detail: Spain took control of the European settlements.

events.title: A French northern zone
events.detail: The Concordia agreement divided the island after Spain withdrew.

events.title: The Knights acquire administration
events.detail: The Order of Saint John purchased proprietary rights under French sovereignty.

events.title: French company administration
events.detail: The sale of the Order’s rights to the French West India Company took effect.

events.title: A brief Dutch occupation
events.detail: Dutch forces took the whole island.

events.title: French forces return
events.detail: French control resumed after two weeks.

events.title: Administration interrupted
events.detail: War and evacuation disrupted organized colonial government.

events.title: French administration returns
events.detail: French settlement and government resumed.

events.title: The French evacuate
events.detail: Colonial administration again withdrew.

events.title: Dutch government of the whole island
events.detail: The Dutch governed the vacant French zone.

events.title: The French zone restored
events.detail: French administration resumed as a dependency of Guadeloupe.

events.title: Raids force settlers to flee
events.detail: British privateers attacked the French side; these raids are not plotted as a durable annexation.

events.title: British forces occupy the French zone
events.detail: A force from Tortola briefly occupied northern Saint Martin.

events.title: France regains the north
events.detail: The British occupation ended.

events.title: Britain takes the island
events.detail: A British expedition occupied both zones.

events.title: French forces retake the island
events.detail: The British occupation ended.

events.title: Dutch government in the French zone
events.detail: A Dutch-backed provisional council took control.

events.title: French republican government returns
events.detail: French forces resumed control.

events.title: British occupation
events.detail: British forces took the whole island.

events.title: French administration returns
events.detail: The Peace of Amiens restored the northern zone.

events.title: Another British occupation
events.detail: The Napoleonic Wars brought British rule again.

events.title: France returns after the peace
events.detail: French administration resumed in the north.

events.title: The Hundred Days brings a final occupation
events.detail: British forces reoccupied the French zone.

events.title: French government restored
events.detail: The final British occupation ended.

events.title: A separate French collectivity
events.detail: Saint Martin separated administratively from Guadeloupe within France.
